patient.name: Maria Santos
patient.address: 418 W Lombard St, Apt 3B, Baltimore, MD 21201

cases.title: Missing-document case
cases.story: Laid off in June and lost his insurance. Gets $1,850/month unemployment and is staying with his sister rent-free, so he has no pay stubs and no rent bill.

unemployment_proof.note: Office of Unemployment Insurance benefit statement

housing.note: Form FAF 116: staying with his sister, room and board free

cases.demoPoint: Tap 'I don't have this' on the rent bill, pick the FAF 116 alternative, readiness updates. Being uninsured raises the Medicaid screening flag for the counselor.
cases.presumptiveVariant: If James says he receives SNAP, he is presumptively eligible for free care and no income or housing documents are needed.

cases.title: Multiple-biller case
cases.story: Broke her wrist; one ER visit produced two bills. Married with two kids, $98,000 household income, high-deductible insurance.

bills.billerName: University of Maryland Faculty Physicians, Inc.

income_proof.note: Has her 2 pay stubs; still needs her husband's
